liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): John Barlow, beside the soundboard near the end of Playing, said it would separate the men from the boys; This Playin appears on the So Many Roads box set, on disc 4 or 5 [11][12]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Opening Iko is described as colorful and playful [12]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): Described as minimalist and stuck in the muck, with Brent's Hammond compensating for the stickiness [18]
- **Candyman** (1 review): The drummers sounded prominent in it, adding to the hazy feel of the show [18]
- **Queen Jane Approximately** (1 review): Reviewer finds it tired, with shoddy singing from Bobby [18]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Listener was amazed that Crazy Fingers was placed between China Cat and Rider [16]
- **Believe It Or Not** (1 review): Rarely played song; reviewer says it resembles Wake Up and Go Home [17]

## Setlist highlights

- **Believe It Or Not**: rare: 9 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-07-29.pzm.russjcan.93970.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 150 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1988-07-29.158384.mtx.photoleon.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 157 min [2]
- **gd1988-07-29.schoeps.litzenberger.watson.86255.sbefail.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 157 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [3]
- **gd88-07-29.sbd.hayum.5395.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 144 min; rated 4.38/5 by 64 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer thinks it sounds like a patched soundboard, crystal clear rather than an audience tape; Recording is taped too loud, and heavier jams distort; Great-sounding audience recording apart from slightly distorted peaks; an earlier circulating version lacked the distortion [12][17][19]
- **gd1988-07-29.set2.sbd.russjcan.105341.flac16**: soundboard; 13 songs; 82 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [8]

## Around the show

- Listener stood next to John Barlow at the soundboard during the second-set Playing [11]
- Half the PA went down during Drums when Healy dropped the octave just as Mickey played Home Plate [15]
- Dan waved at the soundboard while Mickey, seemingly drunk, paid no attention [15]
- Listener attended on his 21st birthday [15]
- It was hot and dusty; the listener watched the second set from a hill overlooking the venue [16]
- David Lindley and El Rayo-X are credited in the notes [2]
- Reviewer says the pre-drums second set holds the most wicked 40 minutes of music the band played in 1988 [13]
- First set and post-drums portion are called rather stock compared with the pre-drums second set [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-07-29.pzm.russjcan.93970.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Russ Cansler; transferred by Russ Cansler; source: Hat Mounted pzm's with Sony WMD6-C 45 feet away,Dead center Maxell MX-90 No nr [1]
- **gd1988-07-29.158384.mtx.photoleon.flac16**: source: Matrix created in Adobe Audition by Joe Noel [2]. Also: Matrix of a soundboard by Dan Healy, processed by Charlie Miller, with a Schoeps source from M. Watson and wklitz [2]
- **gd1988-07-29.schoeps.litzenberger.watson.86255.sbefail.flac16**: transferred by M Watson; source: Schoeps cmc 4/mk2-> Sony pcm-f1->Beta->Dat [3]. Also: Schoeps DAT source loaned by wklitz; right channel raised about half a decibel as the only processing; Mic location was not noted; uploader guesses front-of-board because of little crowd noise and omni capsules [3]
- **gd88-07-29.sbd.hayum.5395.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard( was labeled as Aud CM-> DAT-> CDR-> EAC w/correct offsets using Secure Mode w/C2 (Plextor UW)-> SHN (MKW)) [4]. Also: Audience source on a CM mic to DAT, then CDR, extracted with EAC and converted to SHN, via Andy Hayum; The encore comes from a different audience source [4]
- **gd1988-07-29.set2.sbd.russjcan.105341.flac16**: transferred by Russ Cansler; source: SBD > ? > ? > Cassette (Third Gen sbd cassette maxell XL II no nr) [8]. Also: This is a soundboard copy of the second set only, through the encore Black Muddy River [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1988-07-31 Laguna Seca Recreation Area, Monterey, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1988-07-31-laguna-seca-recreation-area-monterey-ca-usa/) [22]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Laguna Seca Recreation Area - July 29, 1988](https://www.dead.net/show/july-29-1988) [23]
- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1988-07-29 Laguna Seca Recreation Area, Monterey, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1988-07-29-laguna-seca-recreation-area-monterey-ca-usa/) [24]
